text:
PagerBot: :rotating_light: PROD PAGE: high error rate from model-worker pool rwd-model-n1 in us-west-2 — 1200 errors/min, 5% success drop — paging primary oncall now
Maya R: on it, grabbing the bridge. can someone check the autoscaler logs?
Samir P: I see surge from a small subset of prompts hitting long context paths. pushing on logs now.
Kevin L: I'm currently out but can shadow for 30m, I can take deputy. ping me for handoff.
Maya R: thanks @Kevin L — please be primary if this escalates. @Alina S can you confirm customer impact with support?
Alina S: opening a quick CS check with the top affected accounts. early signal shows slow tail for chat streams, some timeouts on streaming connections.
Samir P: logs snippet: ```
2026-03-14T19:02:11Z model-worker-22 WARN kvcache-miss=1 seqlen=8192 latency_ms=1200
2026-03-14T19:02:12Z model-worker-22 ERROR oom while allocating workspace
2026-03-14T19:02:12Z orchestrator ERROR retrying task id=abc123 backoff=0.5s
```
Maya R: looks like long sequence requests + memory pressure. runbook section "model-worker OOM / high seqlen" suggests fallback to smaller variant + restart worker.
ops-runbooks-bot: Runbook link: https://redwood/runbooks/model-worker-oom — steps 1-3 recommended (reduce batch, rotate worker, fallback)
Maya R: executing step 1: throttling high-context prompts via routing rule. posting command to toggle: ```/routing update block_tag=long-context throttle=0.2```
Samir P: applying throttle, will also drop KV cache size on the affected pool: ```kubectl exec -it --namespace=serve model-worker-22 -- /bin/sh -c 'echo 256 > /sys/config/kv_cache_limit'```
Kevin L: I'm taking secondary watch. Maya you're primary?
Maya R: yes primary. Kevin shadowing. Samir doing infra changes, Alina on customer comms.
PagerBot: NOTE: incident annotated with Sev=2, bridge created https://meet/bridge/ins-4800123456
Alina S: CS update: two mid-market customers reported latency-induced retries on 3/14 18:58-19:05 UTC. escalating to AMs. no data exfiltration.
Samir P: after throttle + cache tweak error rate falling to ~150 errors/min. still seeing noisy worker 22. I'm going to drain it and rotate a fresh pod.
Maya R: good call. Samir, include `--skip-cache-warm` so new worker doesn't rehydrate huge KV.
Samir P: draining: ```kubectl cordon model-worker-22 && kubectl drain model-worker-22 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data```
Samir P: new pod up `model-worker-57`, warming with reduced cache. monitoring.
Maya R: Kevin, please prepare a quick handoff note; I'm off in ~20m but can reappear if pager fires. we need overlap with EU late shift.
Kevin L: copy. will summarize on this thread and ping eu-oncall channel for overlap.
Kevin L: HANDOFF SUMMARY: primary Maya R -> outgoing. secondary Kevin L -> incoming. actions taken: throttled long-context routing, reduced kv cache on us-west pool, drained bad pod, spun up smaller-ram worker variant. customer impact: transient latency/timeouts for streaming between 18:58-19:10 UTC for a handful of accounts. next steps: watch error rate for 15m, rollback throttle if stable, follow up with customers.
Maya R: adding runbook pointer: check /metrics/kv_cache_miss_ratio and /metrics/seqlen_histogram — thresholds: miss_ratio < 0.1 and p99 latency < 300ms.
Alina S: CS note: notified affected customers with ETA: probable recovery in 15-30m. will follow with postmortem if customers request.
PagerBot: Reminder: please ack the page in PagerDuty to avoid duplicate notifs.
Kevin L: acked. starting 30m watch. tagging @eu-oncall for overlap: @eu-oncall please shadow from 23:30-00:00 UTC to ensure handoff when EU primary comes online.
Maya R: thanks team. if error rate spikes again, fallback plan is to route traffic to quantized-variant q2 which has lower memory footprint but slightly higher latency. config snippet: ```
route: model-prod
fallback: q2-quantized
percent: 100
```
Samir P: metrics look stable for 5m, errors down to ~30/min. leaving throttle in place for now and will reduce gradually.
Alina S: CS updated customers: reported recovered, will keep open until monitoring green for 30m.
Kevin L: noted. I'll post a short incident note to #postmortems after stable window: cause hypothesis = sudden burst of long-context prompts causing OOM in model-worker with cold cache. mitigation steps performed listed above.
Maya R: handing off primary to Kevin in 10m. I'll stay available on bridge until 19:28 UTC then step out. thanks all :thumbsup:
Kevin L: taking primary. good handoff. :white_check_mark:
PagerBot: Incident status: mitigated -> monitoring.
Maya R: final: please add any missing notes to the postmortem draft and tag impacted customer threads.
Alina S: will follow through.
Kevin L: closing watch but will remain reachable.
PagerBot: Thread archived after 30m of steady-state.
